artifacts.summary: Research confirming the OCR-tier gap, ocrmypdf/tesseract availability, and live corpus evidence for both the text-layer-absence and poor-vintage-OCR failure classes.

Five-phase plan landing actionable OCR-naming failure messaging and a distinct needs-OCR ingest bucket first, then an explicit non-auto LITERATURE_CONVERTER=ocr mode, regression tests, and documentation.

memory_candidates.content: In agent-system/extensions/literature/scripts/literature-convert.sh, exit code 2 is an OVERLOADED failure code with at least two distinct producers: the pre-gate 'all engine tiers produced empty output' path (a genuinely image-only PDF) and the 'LITERATURE_CONVERTER=pymupdf4llm requested but primary tier unavailable/failed' path. Any consumer that needs to distinguish them (e.g. literature-ingest.sh's per-file bucketing) MUST key off a distinctive stderr marker string, never off the bare exit code -- this is the same mechanism the script's exit-3 handling already uses (grep -m1 'QUALITY GATE FAILED'). Applies generally: in this pipeline, exit codes classify severity, stderr markers classify cause.
